objective: Falsify or support incremental economic document interpretation and useful native probability routing across the fixed13-event census; no prices or trading claims.
source_scope: Current-version original capital-spending excerpts from each current and immediately preceding main earnings document. Exact source hashes, offsets, selection omissions and after-call amendments remain recorded. Missing interim disclosures prevent first-public-novelty conclusions.
relationship_to_financial_protocol: Separate closed-document interpretation diagnostic. Does not change frozen financial protocol, economic rule, source requirements or authorize event prices.
inputs_frozen_before_calls: All13 evidence pairs, uniform question panel, source-grounded agent-reviewed labels and numeric annotations, routes, two prepared plans and complete suite hash.
batching: Chronological first12 then last1 solely to reuse the existing development runner max12 fixture guard. Both batches freeze together; shared Store and phase budget. Stop before batch2 if any failure in batch1.
threshold_definition: Chosen-category native probability, not provider confidence statistic and not profit probability.
controls: same original evidence and questions with compact categorical conventional model
Jev chosen categories without probability threshold
independently reviewed annual total-capex numbers plus deterministic midpoint arithmetic
numeric_control: Use only same target annual forecast period and accounting basis with finite prior/current interval bounds. Compare interval midpoints; unavailable/open bounds or incomparable periods remain unknown. Reviewed number selection is disclosed; this is not an automatic raw-document parser.
evaluation_unit: 13 earnings episodes. Atomic questions and multiple routes are dependent diagnostics, not additional independent financial observations.
primary_metrics: incremental correct route decisions versus conventional control
native probability changes that prevent unsupported categorical positives
native probability changes that lose supported categorical positives
secondary_metrics: atomic answer match versus frozen agent-reviewed labels
reference_limit: Agent-reviewed development labels, not human gold or a blind independent market holdout. Surface ambiguities without relabeling the frozen result or rerunning after outputs.

stopping_rules.no_incremental_route_information: Stop expanding this Jev-specific mechanism if it never improves an economic route decision beyond conventional and total-headline controls.
stopping_rules.no_native_routing_benefit: Do not claim native-probability advantage if thresholds never change decisions helpfully, or only discard supported decisions.
stopping_rules.no_supported_variation: Treat the financial rule as untestable on this population if the source references show no relevant variation; no lowering thresholds to manufacture signals.
stopping_rules.small_positive: At most justifies a prospective paper test with observable source timestamps. Does not establish profitable alpha.
stopping_rules.historical_eligibility: Unknown complete prior public state or exact source-version availability remains unknown; no executable-P&L claim.
